Bill.BriefDescription: Simplifying definitions and classifications concerning state and local tax systems.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to simplifying definitions and classificationsconcerning state and local tax systems; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of revenue must establish awork group to evaluate and develop recommendations on issues related tosimplifying existing law in regards to city and state business andoccupation tax uniformity, classifications, apportionment, and nexus.The work group must consist of members representing: The department ofrevenue; the association of Washington cities; Seattle, Bellevue,Bellingham, Tacoma, and Everett; policy groups that have evaluated thestate's tax system; and statewide business organizations. Further, anycity imposing a local business and occupation tax may opt to havemembers participate in the work group. (2) By December 15, 2013, and in compliance with RCW 43.01.036, thedepartment of revenue must submit a report to the appropriatelegislative committees that details the work group's recommendationsunder this section.
